kde.dialog.confirm.name: kde.dialog.confirm
kde.dialog.confirm.description: Show a Yes/No confirmation dialog. Returns user's choice.
examples: Ask the user before deleting these files.
Confirm with the user that they want to restart the application.
Get user permission to proceed with this irreversible action.

prompt.description: The question to show in the dialog body.

title.description: Optional dialog title (defaults to the agent's app name).

default.description: Which button is the default focus.

kde.notifications.send.name: kde.notifications.send
kde.notifications.send.description: Send a KDE Plasma desktop notification with a title and body.

Show a desktop alert saying backup finished.
